_comment: Goldens for the isolated SHARC handler harness (agree-subtract-compare). effects lists contain postA==postB!=baseline entries as addr:base->injected. Frames and PC samples are never compared: sub-frame handlers are invisible to per-frame PC polling.

00._comment: add service with 1.0, 2.0: result leaves via the output FIFO (not DM), so the DM effect set is empty; outcome proves inject->dispatch->handler->idle

fd._comment: output-FIFO drain after a scalar trial, keyed by predecessor opcode: 3.0 after 00 (1.0+2.0), 1.0 after 01 (2.0-1.0) and 02 (0.5*2.0)

01._comment: subtract service with 2.0, 1.0: result via output FIFO, no DM effects

02._comment: multiply service with 0.5, 2.0: result via output FIFO, no DM effects

03._comment: division service with 1.0, 2.0: result leaves via the output FIFO (not DM), so the DM effect set is empty; judged only under a spec that feeds it two args

04._comment: division-residual service: 0.0 out for (1,2) and (3,2) via FIFO, no DM effects

0e._comment: 4-word parameter store to DM 0x30105-0x30108; exact set pinned for the canonical probe words

11._comment: 12-word state readback: no DM writes of its own (cumulative footprint comes from the preceding 07), returns to idle; drain content proved manually

19._comment: counter readback: FIFO output only, no DM writes; drain content (0, then 3) proved manually

20._comment: 3-word tail readback: FIFO output only, no DM writes; drain content proved manually

26._comment: 5-word parameter store to DM 0x3013c-0x30140; exact set pinned for the canonical probe words

2f._comment: 3-word interpolation over the upload record: DM writes are input- and table-dependent, so only the return is judged; deltas proved manually

21._comment: 6-word parameter store to DM 0x30136-0x3013b; exact set pinned for the canonical probe words

10._comment: 12-word diagonal-identity init over a garbage-prefilled upload record

05._comment: upload-record advance: outcome pinned; write-set is source-dependent so only the return is judged

06._comment: counter decrement: dynamically a no-op (counter snapshot-invisible); outcome pinned

07._comment: 12-word upload: write-set is input-dependent so only the return is judged

08._comment: service-state init: effect set pinned after first validated run
